summary: The blind compare flagged nothing: my independent answers matched every key and judge verdict. On the full read I fixed two near-duplicate frames (065 vs 063, 075 vs 069), two sentences that read awkwardly (练弹钢琴, a bare 下决心), one off-level word (蹲), two distractors whose rejection was overclaimed (做手续, 起病), and two why texts that overclaimed (打灯, 吃烟). Judgement calls I left alone: 把灯开一下, 把电视的声音开小一点儿 and 洗牙 as a judge error, all of which follow the guide.

collocations-01-002.note: 练弹钢琴 is clumsy; removed 练 so the sentence is plain 在弹钢琴.

collocations-01-017.note: Dropped 蹲下来 (beyond HSK 4, not the point being tested).

collocations-01-027.note: The why said 打灯 is not Chinese, but 打开灯 is standard; the why now says 打 needs 开 (打开).

collocations-01-035.note: The why called 吃烟 English-driven, but 吃烟 is dialectal; reworded to say "not standard".

collocations-01-044.note: The why claimed 做手续 does not exist (it is heard in speech); replaced the 做 distractor with 开.

collocations-01-058.note: Bare 我下决心，从明天起 read oddly as a statement of a past decision; added 了 so it matches "I've made up my mind".

collocations-01-065.note: Almost the same sentence as 063 (想去邮局给老家的…寄); rewrote the frame.

collocations-01-075.note: Near duplicate of judge 069 (每天早上起床以后先…牙，再…); new frame.

collocations-01-087.note: 起病 is a real medical term (onset of illness); replaced the 起 distractor with 取.
